hasAction.description: Decision D5: the meaning of the type (prefLabel, definition, subClassOf) is kept apart from the rest. The six-phase position moves from skos:broader to pp:phase (classification); profile, processDescription and provenanceClass move to a node of their own (pp:deployment); the openEO correspondences are grouped apart. The plan was already a node of its own.

roleDecompositions added: the role areaOfInterest of raster-crop is taken as mode.extent.ulx, uly, lrx, lry and mode.extent.unit, with mode = extent (decision of 2026-11-09); before, the role was left unbound.

subClassOf changes from https://w3id.org/ogc/rim/activity-type/ActivityType to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/raster-crop, the activity type of the operation in bblocks-generic-profiles (decision of 2026-11-10), with the same entity type(s): http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature, http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature.
The role decomposition is restricted to mode.extent.unit in phy or lonlat, a selector instead of a part: with the default unit pxl the four numbers are pixel indices, not a bounding box.

The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-process-profiles/def/process-type/raster/extract-roi to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/process-profiles/process-type/raster/extract-roi, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/process-profiles/process-type/raster/extract-roi/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.

prefLabel: Extract a ROI defined by the user.
definition: This application extracts a Region Of Interest with user parameters. There are four mode of extraction. The standard mode allows the user to enter one point (upper left corner of the region to extract) and a size. The extent mode needs two points (upper left corner and lower right) and the radius mode need the center of the region and the radius: it will extract the rectangle containing the circle defined and limited by the image dimension. The fit mode needs a reference image or vector and the dimension of the extracted region will be the same as the extent of the reference. Different units are available such as pixel, image physical space or longitude and latitude.

roleDecompositions.note: With `mode` set to `extent` and `mode.extent.unit` set to `phy` (coordinates in the image's physical space, its CRS) or `lonlat` (longitude and latitude), OTB ExtractROI takes the area of interest as the upper-left (`mode.extent.ulx`, `mode.extent.uly`) and lower-right (`mode.extent.lrx`, `mode.extent.lry`) corners, plain numbers, not as one OGC API - Processes bounding box: the representation bounding-box-ogcapi-processes-bbox of the role is not served. With the default unit `pxl` the four numbers are pixel indices, not a bounding box, and the role is not implemented.

openeoEquivalence.rationale: OTB.ExtractROI's "extent" mode (`mode.extent.ulx/uly/lrx/lry`, two corner points) matches filter_bbox's role (spatially limit a data cube to a bounding box). Not exactMatch: three other modes have no openEO equivalent -- pixel-offset/size ("standard": `startx`/`starty`/ `sizex`/`sizey`), circular ("radius": `mode.radius.r`/`cx`/`cy`), and reference-geometry ("fit": `mode.fit.im`/`vect`) extraction.
